text:
maya: Quick sanity check — before we call this GA, I want final answers on three things: SLA wording for p99 latency, docs tutorial for private deploy, and oncall rotation for pricing disputes. Can folks ack ownership?

eli: I can take SLA wording + SLO numbers. Need target p50/p95/p99 and error budget cadence.

sophia: I'll own docs + examples for private deploy; timeline: end of week if we stick to current PR reviews.

noah: Oncall coverage for pricing disputes — can we map to billing-oncall? Right now the rota isn't formalized.

maya: Proposal: p50 50ms, p95 150ms, p99 350ms for hosted; dedicated customers get 99th SLA 250ms with credit tiers. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

eli: Numbers seem reasonable for small contexts but p99 350ms might be optimistic for long-context workloads. We should make SLA conditional on model family & seq length. Draft snippet to consider:

"SLA applies to requests using models from the Redwood-verified catalog with input length <= 1024 tokens; requests outside this bound are best-effort and not covered by the latency SLA."

sophia: That conditionality should be surfaced in both the SLA doc and the private-deploy quickstart. I'll add a banner in the guide about the seq-length caveat + example config.

noah: For oncall, practice: billing disputes -> billing-oncall (24h ack) -> product escalation for policy exceptions. I'll work with ops to formalize that.

maya: Monitoring: need concrete alert thresholds. My suggestion: p99 latency increase > 25% vs baseline for 15m; error rate > 0.5% for 10m; token-cost-per-minute spike > 30% for 10m. Who owns these alerts?

eli: I can own latency alerting + the runbook. Quick runbook sketch: 1) verify metric, 2) rollback to last model variant, 3) scale up dedicated pool if needed, 4) page eng-runtime if unresolved after 10m.

sophia: Docs smoke: add a private deploy quickstart + KMS snippet + audit-log example. Also add a minimal troubleshooting section referencing the runbook. Can someone review my PR tomorrow?

maya: Pricing: decision on burst credits — propose we offer a 1M-token burst window for Dedicated pilot (no charge), then transition to metered billing. Need legal & finance signoff.

noah: I'll ping Legal and Finance now. Also will add per-route cost-per-token to the monitoring dashboard so ops can triage customer billing questions faster.

deploy-bot: Reminder — staging smoke tests scheduled at 2025-11-02T09:00Z :robot_face: 

eli: For acceptance criteria, propose a simple checklist we can gate on:
- SLA language drafted and reviewed
- Docs PR merged with private-deploy quickstart and KMS example
- Oncall rotation updated and contact points listed
- Monitoring alerts created and runbooks attached
- Pricing commitment recorded and legal note appended
If all boxes ✅ we flip the launch flag for the policy & docs surface.

maya: I'll add this checklist to the launch doc and owner-tag each item. Sophia/eli/noah please update by EOD Fri. :+1: 

sophia: Ack — will finish docs PR and post the link here when ready.

eli: Ack — drafting SLA text now, will paste for quick review before EOD.

noah: Ack — updating rotation and dashboard, will confirm escalation path in the billing runbook.

maya: Thanks all — if anything blocks, drop blockers here. Otherwise we'll treat this thread as the final readiness gate for the policy items (SLA/docs/oncall/monitoring/pricing). :rocket:
